# Climbing

> > Climbing.com is the premier online resource for rock climbing, mountaineering, and alpine pursuits, featuring news, skills training, gear reviews, and expedition coverage.

The site covers everything from technical climbing skills and training methods to conservation efforts by organizations like the Access Fund, accident analysis, and firsthand reports from iconic locations including Longs Peak, the Gunks, and international destinations. Contributors include expert climbers and journalists covering topics from sport climbing to Everest expeditions.

## Key Topics

- Climbing skills and technique
- Climbing training and kettlebell workouts
- Gear reviews and climbing shoes
- Accident analysis and safety
- Access Fund and conservation
- Gunks Traverse
- Longs Peak and the Diamond
- Climbing culture and psychology
- Mountaineering and expeditions
- Ice climbing and big wall climbing
- Soloing
- Climbing travel destinations
- Alex Honnold and Dawn Wall
- BLM and public lands access

## Skills and Training

- [Bennett Slavsky Archives](https://www.climbing.com/byline/bennett-slavsky): Bennett Slavsky's articles on training, Gunks traverse, and conservation
- [Alice Hafer Archives](https://www.climbing.com/byline/alice-hafer): Alice Hafer on climbing psychology, anxiety, and relationships

## Gear and Equipment

- [Climbing Shoes Archives](https://www.climbing.com/byline/climbing-shoes): Climbing shoe gear reviews and equipment selection guides

## Safety and Accident Reports

- [Annie Weinmann Archives](https://www.climbing.com/byline/annie-weinmann): Annie Weinmann's accident analysis and Longs Peak climbing reports

## Expeditions and Adventure

- [Brian Irwin Archives](https://www.climbing.com/byline/brian-irwin): Brian Irwin's Everest coverage and Nepal mountaineering reports
- [Corey Buhay Archives](https://www.climbing.com/byline/corey-buhay): Corey Buhay's ice climbing, big wall, and Dolomites coverage

## Culture and Community

- [Chris Parker Archives](https://www.climbing.com/byline/chris-parker): Chris Parker on Dawn Wall, Alex Honnold, and climbing culture
